title: FHIR Bundle summary with preliminary and partial DiagnosticReports (pending results) and a stopped MedicationRequest (ibuprofen); pneumonia, home

rationale.pending_results: EDGE (FHIR): the preliminary blood culture and partial Legionella antigen DiagnosticReports flatten into a Pending Results list, and the narrative names Dr. Mensah's office as owner of follow-up; the final viral panel is correctly not listed as pending.
rationale.med_changes: EDGE (FHIR): the stopped ibuprofen MedicationRequest appears under Medications Stopped with its reason, and the active requests carry 'new' or 'unchanged' notes.
rationale.discharge_meds: The four active MedicationRequests form the discharge medication list with doses; the stopped ibuprofen is correctly excluded from it.
rationale.final_diagnosis: Encounter-diagnosis Conditions (pneumonia, AKI) are the discharge diagnoses; asthma is a problem-list item.
rationale.meds_consistent: Nursing lists the same four active medications and tells the patient to stop ibuprofen, matching the stopped request; 'Albuterol inhaler' versus 'Albuterol HFA' is the same drug.
